thread:
Priya (CS): Hey team — FinServX reports quantized endpoint (int8/4bit) p95 is ~420ms vs fp16 p95 ~160ms since last calibration run. They say this started after we pushed the new int8 kernel on 1943090000.
Ethan (Runtime): ugh, seen that on staging too briefly. Do we have a timeline? :eyes:
Priya (CS): Customer noticed after 05:30 UTC; production deploy at ~05:10. I'm including their quick traces: p50 60ms, p95 420ms, throughput roughly same. They say cold starts not the issue — sustained.
Maya (ML): can you paste the model + quant config? calib flags?
Priya (CS): Model: redwood/gpt-baseline-13b, quant: int8 dynamic, per-channel, calibration run id: calib-2026-03-16-17. KV cache enabled, batching target 3, autoscale on. Customer session id: fsx-998.
Ethan (Runtime): ok starting perf repro. Can you whitelist fsx-998 to route to our staging cluster? I'll run a profiling pass.
DeployBot: @Ethan triggered perf profile job perf-1943104570-1 on staging-quant with trace collection.
Jon (Oncall): FYI I'll watch SLO/alerts while we triage.
Ethan (Runtime): Initial flame from profile: heavy time in kernel quant_matmul_v2 and kernel_fallback_runner. Observed frequent kernel swap events when sequence len > 1024. KV cache hit rate fluctuates 45-78% depending on prompt pattern. Batching histogram skewed: many single-request batches during streams.
Maya (ML): that kernel swap on seq>1024 suggests our kernel selection heuristic picked small-seq optimized int8 kernels that don't vectorize well for current layout. Any kernel logs?
Ethan (Runtime): paste:
```
[t=0.234] selected kernel: int8_gemm_small_seq
[t=0.235] fallback to int8_gemm_generic (higher latency)
[t=0.236] selected kernel: fp16_gemm_vector (not available for int8)
```
Ethan (Runtime): Also saw repeated small-batch invocations (batch_size 1-2) causing poor throughput and losing batching advantages.
Maya (ML): Possible causes: calibration produced per-tensor scales that cause extra int8 dequant/dequant ops or extra correction kernels. Also KV cache layout changed post-calib -> more cache evictions -> more repeated recompute.
Priya (CS): Customer shared a short transcript — repeated prefix pattern, so cache should help but they report high eviction.
Ethan (Runtime): I ran a quick patch toggling KV cache eviction threshold higher (retain more), and forcing batch_delay_ms=8 -> staging p95 dropped to 180ms for int8 variant. So a path forward: raise eviction threshold + slight batching increase.
Maya (ML): We should also try a calibration rollback: re-run calibration with per-channel symmetric vs asymmetric scales. I suspect asymmetric per-channel created larger dynamic range and triggered extra dequant corrections.
Jon (Oncall): Any risk to immediate change on production? Customer is sensitive.
Ethan (Runtime): Mitigation plan: 1) Route FSX traffic to FP16 variant for 2 hours (low risk), 2) Apply eviction threshold + batch_delay bump on a small percentage of pods (canary), 3) Re-run calibration with symmetric per-channel and test, 4) If good, roll back quant kernel selection heuristic to prefer generic int8_gemm_generic for seq>512 until we validate.
Priya (CS): Customer asks for ETA. ETA for routing -> 15m. For canary/eviction change -> 45m. For new calibration + validation -> 4-6 hours.
Maya (ML): I'll start calibration now and post artefacts.
Ethan (Runtime): Added logs/flags to help root cause: kernel_select_debug=1, kv_eviction_debug=1; perf traces at /artifacts/perf-1943104570.tar.gz
Priya (CS): Drafting customer message: "Thanks — we've identified a regression in kernel selection and cache behavior for the int8 variant. We can temporarily route you to fp16 immediately and will test mitigation that typically resolves this within a few hours. Will share results and next steps." Thoughts?
Maya (ML): that's good. add: "we'll share repro artifacts and a timeline for a permanent fix."
Priya (CS): Sent to customer, they ack'd :thumbsup: 
Ethan (Runtime): canary applied: 10% pods got eviction+batch_delay changes; observing p95 drop in canary to ~170ms. No errors.
Jon (Oncall): alerts stable. No change to error rate.
Maya (ML): calibration finished; new calib id calib-2026-03-18-04-symm. Initial perf on staging int8 with new scales shows p95 ~165ms when combined with eviction/batching changes. Looks promising.
Ethan (Runtime): Next steps: 1) apply canary to 50% with new calib + heuristic tweak, 2) monitor for 1h, 3) full rollout. I'll open a follow-up postmortem ticket and link traces.
Priya (CS): Customer ok with canary rollout. I'll update CS ticket.
DeployBot: @Priya created ticket CS-7241 "FinServX int8 p95 regression - mitigation & rollouts".
Priya (CS): Thanks team. Closing loop once full rollout done. :white_check_mark:
